description: AgentEval CLI — terminal + CI/CD entry point for the .NET evaluation toolkit. The agenteval init command bootstraps a .agenteval/ workspace; agenteval bench {gdpr|eu-ai-act|agentic|owasp|mitre|perf|longmemeval|memory} runs benchmark families; agenteval mc serve launches the local Mission Control portal (requires .NET 10); agenteval doctor verifies workspace integrity via canonical-JSON audit-chain hashing.
releaseNotes: Install: dotnet tool install --global AgentEval.Cli --prerelease. Per-version release notes: https://github.com/AgentEvalHQ/AgentEval/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
